name: Family Immigration with a Norwegian or Nordic Citizen

qualifying_event.description: For the spouse or registered partner of a Norwegian or Nordic citizen (or a person with permanent residence/qualifying status in Norway), where the marriage/partnership is valid, genuine, and not a forced or circumvention marriage.
qualifying_event.evidence_hint: Marriage/partnership certificate recognized in Norway; sponsor's income documentation; identity documents; plans to live together in Norway.

requirements.blocker_text: Both the applicant and the sponsor must be at least 24 years old.
The sponsor must have had at least NOK 436,957 in annual pre-tax income the year before, and must maintain it through the year the family member receives a permit and during processing.
The marriage/partnership must be valid and recognized in Norway, and not a forced or circumvention marriage.

outcome.duration_length: typically tied to the sponsor's status; renewable

sources.title: UDI -- Family immigration with a Norwegian or Nordic citizen: NOK 436,957/year sponsor income requirement, 24-year minimum age for both parties, genuine-marriage and no-forced/circumvention-marriage requirements

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Norway). No Norwegian-language or integration-course requirement is imposed at this application stage per the tier-1 source (language only becomes relevant later, at no_naturalisation.json's B1 requirement). pr_after_months (36) reflects the 3-year PR track confirmed for 'family immigration with Nordic/Norwegian citizens' specifically (a faster track than the 5-year track for family members of refugees, which is not this route).
